decision.reason: [ev-a641c063f2d6] is only a one-line changelog title. It says metrics were updated to reflect function and controller scope, and it points to PR #6640. It names no metric, label or family. It also doesn't say whether metrics were renamed, relabelled, added or removed, and gives no before/after values or effect on existing dashboards or alerts. The PR diff or the changed metric definitions are needed to write the subject, change, applicability and consequence.
